d:
There will always be opinions. People who think they know what’s best for you. Voices telling you who you should be, what you should want or which path you should choose.
But no one has lived your life. No one has felt what you’ve felt or carries what you carry. Take time to become quiet enough to hear yourself again. Beneath the noise of expectations, fear and comparison, there’s a voice that has always known the way.
Stay true to your heart. It may not always lead you down the easiest road, but it will lead you toward the life that is truly yours
